boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 北美降雪量最高的山口之一：Richardson 公路穿越嶺線，兩側在晚春仍有雪牆，山體層疊直抵 Worthington 冰川方向；「層次」由霧霾與中低雲決定。
boosters_i18n.en: One of North America's snowiest mountain passes: the Richardson Highway crosses the ridge with snow walls persisting into late spring and stacked ridges running toward Worthington Glacier; the depth layering is decided by haze and low/mid cloud.
boosters_i18n.ja: 北米有数の降雪量を誇る山岳峠。リチャードソン・ハイウェイは晩春まで雪壁が残り、層状の尾根がウォーシントン氷河方面へ続く。奥行きの階調はヘイズと中低雲で決まる。

penalties_i18n.en: Severe weather, poor visibility, outside operating/season window.
